notes: Amber dusk is a theme now, not only a widget preset: the same gold-olive and charcoal as a wall for the whole app — near-black olive behind everything, a raised olive panel, and the sun gold as the accent. It is the first card in Static themes this time, with a NEW tag, and the tag clears itself next release.

The liquid one was there all along. The glass widget is the first preset in Settings › Widget and has been since it shipped — it was called “Frosted glass”, so looking for “liquid” found nothing. It is called Liquid glass now. Same preset, same colours, same Frost dial.

The liquid glass preview reads as glass again: a brighter specular band drifting across the pane, a stronger rim on both edges, and the colour behind it pushed less hard, so the pane sits on the wallpaper instead of disappearing into it. The transparency itself is unchanged — this is sheen, not milk.
Nothing else moved — the other nineteen widget presets, the Frost dial, the fine-tune palette, the glass mode, the player, the library, the lyrics and the audio graph are exactly as they were.
